author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Conservative genus-level living reconstruction informed by Clypeaster cortesei PRI78786: a thick rounded test and five petal-shaped surface fields. Nominal 0.125m scale, living cover, colour and unobserved proportions are artistic; not a specimen-perfect or species-diagnostic restoration.
description.zh: 参考 Clypeaster cortesei PRI78786 的属级保守生活形态复原，保留厚实圆壳与五瓣表面区域；约0.125米尺度、活体覆盖、颜色和未知比例为创作，不作标本级精确复原或种级鉴定。
